processing: WebP format conversion quality 87 only; original preserved. CSS positions display the twelve original panels.
style: Ordinary contemporary amateur iPhone snapshots of identifiable objects in Japanese homes and gardens; no written labels or category color coding.
historicalAccuracyBoundary: The black head ornament is an invented illustrative prop, not a source-verified reconstruction of kuro-mikazura. All pictures are generated modern illustrations of objects, not photographic records of mythological events.
review: All twelve generated panels visually inspected, actual atlas used in browser tests. Whether users recognize each object and enjoy the puzzle requires playtesting.
